description: This Java class 'LoanApplicationTransitionValidator' is responsible for validating various state transitions and API request payloads related to loan application processes, such as approval, rejection, and applicant withdrawal, within the Fineract project. It ensures correct status changes, active client/group validation, and proper request data.

classes.name: LoanApplicationTransitionValidator
classes.description: A component class responsible for validating state transitions and request data related to loan applications such as approval, rejection, and withdrawal within the Fineract loan domain.

methods.name: validateApproval
methods.description: Validates the JSON payload for approving a loan application, ensuring all required fields are present and correctly formatted.

methods.name: validateRejection
methods.description: Validates the JSON payload and performs validation logic for rejecting a loan application, including state transition legality.

methods.name: validateApplicantWithdrawal
methods.description: Validates the JSON payload and state transition for an applicant-initiated withdrawal of the loan application.

methods.name: validateLoanRejection
methods.description: Performs validation checks specific to the rejection process, including client/group activity status and loan state transitions.

methods.name: validateLoanApplicantWithdrawal
methods.description: Performs validation checks specific to applicant withdrawal, including state transition validation.

methods.name: checkClientOrGroupActive
methods.description: Checks if the client or group associated with the loan is active; throws exception if not.

methods.name: validateAccountStatus
methods.description: Validates that the loan's current status allows the intended transition related to rejection or withdrawal.
